//: Frozen high-precision deviance references, read by validation/grid/compare.R's gate 1 in place of the oracle deviances for a cell whose manifest entry carries `dev_ref` (gen_manifest.R's DEV_REF). These cells have data where the reference engines' OWN f64 round-off is larger than dev_eps, so no oracle deviance can gate them; gate 1 keeps the normal dev_eps and the normal sign rule, just against the value here instead of best_oracle_dev's oracle comparison. Not a divergences.json-style registry: there is no band to grow stale, only a fixed reference value with its own provenance.
//fields: cell: the grid cell id. value: the frozen reference, on the same aligned-deviance scale aligned_dev() reports for that cell (for this gaussian REML cell, -2 * restricted log-likelihood + the REML constant, glmm's own alignment addend of 0). theta: the LMM variance-ratio parameter the value was evaluated at. method: how value was computed. date: when it was pinned. script: the repo-relative path to the generator that reproduces it.

entries.method: REML criterion evaluated in 60-digit arithmetic (mpmath, dps=60) directly from the CSV's doubles, at lme4's fitted theta -- the smallest of the three engines' 60-digit values, which agree with each other to 1e-10 on the true objective
